# ASCENT Nexus - Wire Lab 3.0 Crystal Wire

> ASCII Successor with Compatible Encoding of Named Text - a wire encoding that keeps classic 7-bit ASCII bit-identical on 0x00-0x7F forever, then adds agent control tokens, multimodal references, quantum-safe envelopes, and a deep-space ECC profile.

## One-liner

ASCENT is the encoding contract that refuses to forget ASCII while remaining agent-native and deep-space ready.

## Parse law

If a byte is less than 0x80, it is classic 7-bit ASCII, width 1, forever. Overlong encodings of ASCII are illegal. LONG F5 03 + u24be MUST reject cp < 0x80 and any scalar that fits a shorter 2/3/4-byte form (first legal LONG is U+2C280).

## Profiles

- ASCENT-7: pure classic ASCII identity
- ASCENT-E: Earth / general interchange
- ASCENT-E-LEO: Starlink-class IP, light CRC or short RS, no full P9
- ASCENT-D: deep-space outer ECC (default RS(255,223), erase on parity fail)
- ASCENT-A: archive / self-description heavy

## Nexus Wire Lab 3.0 features

- Dual text/hex live sync, color byte map, hex dump, decoded units
- Encoding guard sample: LONG F5 03 overlong ASCII / non-minimal width hard-fault
- Command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K), focus lab, compact density
- Mission HUD + stream timeline for captain-log / mixed streams
- Agent frame composer (ROLE TOOL THINK HANDOFF CAP SAFETY STOP)
- Multimodal playground (REF INLINE CHUNK)
- ASCENT-D outer-frame bit-error simulator with real RS(255,223) (erase-on-fail)
- AEGIR algorithm registry + lab envelope sketch
- Interactive 11-plane architecture explorer
- Gallery samples, 2-minute tour, SPEC try-this, codegen (Python/JS/Rust/agent loop)
- Shareable URL hash state, copy hex, download .ascent.bin
- Architecture infographic v3.0.0 + SkyPulse PATHHINT (LEO usable goodput, not RF Mbps)
- Dual-mode Starlink plan (CLOUD / EDGE / QUEUE)
- Fontshare Clash Display + Satoshi, OKLCH tokens, 44px targets
- Python package ascent-wire (`pip install -e .`); JS/Python golden lock in tests/

## Agent loops

See GitHub docs/AGENT-LOOP.md - fenced ROLE/TOOL/THINK/SAFETY on the same stream as prose.

## Quick answers

Q: Does ASCENT break existing ASCII files?
A: No. Pure ASCII files are valid ASCENT-7.

Q: Is this just Unicode renamed?
A: No. It is a stream grammar with fixed fences, length-prefixed agent/media frames, self-describing DEF documents, and optional outer ECC.

Q: How do agents ride the stream?
A: 0x9A open, 0xC1 opcode frame, 0x9B close. Initial opcodes: STOP ROLE TOOL THINK HANDOFF CAP SAFETY.

Q: How does multimodal work?
A: 0x9D 0x4D markers with kind REF/INLINE/CHUNK/END, codec, hash, and length-prefixed body.

Q: Does SkyPulse make Starlink faster at RF?
A: No. PATHHINT is a fail-closed goodput/CCA hint (next_capacity, freeze, obstruction). ASCENT-E-LEO prefers light CRC and no P9 RS on interactive IP. ASCENT-D stays for spool/deep-space.

Q: Where is the normative code?
A: GitHub Pitchfork-and-Torch/ascent - SPEC.md and ref/ascent_codec.py. Site JS tracks frozen Cont 0xA0-0xBF packing.
